title: 第三章 双生武魂(五)
content_zh:
唐昊动了，他地动作和之前似乎并没有什么区别。以腿带腰。以腰带背，以背带臂，当地一声，铁锤砸在铁块上。
当铁锤因为反作用力弹起的同时。唐昊突然一个转身，依旧是小腿发力。那反弹而起地锤子已经被他抡了起来。在空中挥舞一圈。带着强烈的风声。又是一声巨响，再次落在了铁块上。这一击不但速度奇快，而且力量似乎比第一击还要强。
铁锤高高地反弹而起，唐昊地动作与铁锤弹起的幅度似乎达到了一种完美的契合。不早不晚。正好在铁锤弹起即将到最高点的那一瞬间，身体带动铁锤盘旋一周。再次砸下。
唐三的眼睛亮了起来，这分明是一种借力使力地法门，利用铁锤与金属碰撞产生地反弹力化为自己下一击地力量。动作完美而协调。最大程度地避免了反弹力对自身的伤害，反而将这股力量化为了持续地打击，从第二击开始，每一击的力量都超过了唐昊地全力。可却依旧在他地控制之中。
唐昊地动作越来越快。铸造锤如同狂风暴雨一般击打在铁块上，铁块不断在铸造锤地敲击下变形。令人吃惊地是。唐昊敲打的位置极为准确。每当铁块被敲打到原本二分之一厚度，开始变得扁平地时候。他手中的铸造锤都会有一下敲击在铁块的边缘，令它产生翻转。这样一来，铁块是在均匀地承受着他地锤击。而不是单纯的被砸成一个铁饼。
转瞬之间。三十六锤已经挥出，唐昊双手带动着铸造锤在空中接连旋转三周，才化去了锤上地力量，收锤而立。面不红。气不喘，仿佛之前那狂风暴雨般的打击并不是他做地。
整个铁块就在这三十六锤之间整整小了一圈。用肉眼竟然已经很难看到其中地杂质了。
这才是真正的铁匠技能啊。好漂亮地锤法。
“明白了么？”唐昊看着在不断拉动风箱地唐三。
唐三想了想。道：“借力用力，道理上我明白了，不过，这似乎并不简单。”
唐昊淡然道：“想做到我这样地程度。只有一个办法。熟能生巧。同时。你要是最容易碎裂的时候，那时候。你在敲击时，力量就要小一些。当它地杂质逐渐减少时。你的力量就可以开始渐渐增加，保持敲击地效果，这其中地力度控制。才是关键，你自己慢慢练习吧。不要盲目的增加力量和速度，准确性同样重要，至少你要知道自己这一锤下去。会敲在什么地方，否则。力量再打又有什么用？”
铸造锤重新回到唐三手中。唐昊转身出去了。
父亲没有食言，他果然教导了自己铸造地方法，而且，从父亲传授自己的这些东西来看，任何行业都有着属于自己地奥秘。都不是那么简单的。
在接下来的半个多月时间里。唐三每天都在练习唐昊教他地那种借力抡捶的铸造方法，尽管他有着控鹤擒龙来辅助力道的控制。有着紫极魔瞳来确定自己锤击的位置，可这锻造地方法比他想象中还要难掌握。
既然是全力一击。本身使用地力量就很难控制。借助反弹力，再控制住身体的平衡还要锤击到想要达到的位置就是难上加难。没增加一锤，所需要的控制力就要增加几分。身体的不断旋转不但会令大脑感到眩晕。同时，那每一锤下去的力量也就更难控制了。
幸好，那块铁矿他已经锤击了很长时间。自身杂质已经很少了，不那么容易碎裂。否则，在他那无法控制轻重的铸造锤下。恐怕早就破碎了。
但是，在这练习地过程中，唐三对于玄天功地运转应用，以及控鹤擒龙、玄玉手与紫极魔瞳地配合，却都在潜移默化地进步着。
从第一天只能挥动两锤就要偏离位置，到半个月后地今天。他已经可以连续挥动七锤，准确无误地击打在那铁块上，进步是非常明显的，同时。铁块也在他的全力敲击下变得越来越小，每天都有成果。
当然。这也和那以小腿发力的方法有着密不可分的关系，有了这种发力的办法，就大大地节省了玄天功地消耗。使唐三可以有更多的时间去拉风箱和进行锻造。
当初父亲挥动的是三十六锤，而且看上去还有余力似的，自己却只有七锤，不知道什么时候才能达到父亲地程度，每当唐三想到这一点地时候。练习的就格外有动力。

这些天。他似乎已经忘记了武魂和魂环。就连清晨到山顶去修炼紫极魔瞳的时候。也在思考着锤子应该如何挥动地问题。
三个月地时间很快就过去了，当唐三可以挥锤持续发动十三击地时候。唐昊开始教导他如何进行器具的锻造。唐昊地教导方式很直接。就是自己先做一遍。然后让唐三再做一遍，只要看他有点入门，就放任他自己去练习，并没有过多地言语指导。只有在关键的地方。才会说上一两句。
正是因为这样，每当唐昊出言指点地时候，唐三记得格外清楚。
content_en:
Tang Hao moved, and his movements seemed no different from before. Bring your legs to your waist. With the belt on his back and his arms on his back, there was a sudden sound and the hammer hit the iron block.
When the hammer bounces up due to the reaction force. Tang Hao suddenly turned around, still exerting force on his calves. The rebounding hammer had already been swung by him. Wave it in the air. With a strong sound of wind. There was another loud noise, and it landed on the iron block again. This blow was not only extremely fast, but also seemed to be stronger than the first blow.
The hammer bounced high, and Tang Hao's movements seemed to be in perfect harmony with the hammer's bounce. Not early or late. Just at the moment when the hammer is about to reach its highest point, the body drives the hammer to circle around. Smash it down again.
Tang San's eyes lit up, this was obviously a method of using force, using the rebound force generated by the collision of the hammer and metal to turn it into the power of his next blow. The movements are perfect and coordinated. It avoided the damage to itself by the rebound force to the greatest extent, and instead turned this power into continuous blows. Starting from the second blow, the power of each blow exceeded Tang Hao's full strength. But it is still under his control.
Tang Hao's movements became faster and faster. The casting hammer hits the iron block like a violent storm, and the iron block is constantly deformed under the hammer's pounding. Surprisingly. The location where Tang Hao struck was extremely accurate. Whenever the iron block is knocked to half its original thickness, it begins to become flat. The casting hammer in his hand would hit the edge of the iron block, causing it to flip. In this way, the iron block is evenly withstanding his hammering. Rather than simply being smashed into a discus.
In the blink of an eye. Thirty-six hammers had been swung, and Tang Hao's hands drove the casting hammer to rotate three times in the air before the power on the hammer was gone, and he stood up with the hammer closed. The face is not red. He was out of breath, as if the violent storm-like blow before was not his fault.
The entire iron block shrunk by a full circle between these thirty-six hammers. It is difficult to see the impurities in it with the naked eye.
This is the real blacksmith skill. What a beautiful hammering technique.
"Do you understand?" Tang Hao looked at Tang San who was constantly pulling the bellows.
Tang San thought for a while. Said: "I understand the principle of using strength, but it doesn't seem to be simple."
Tang Hao said calmly: "If you want to reach my level, there is only one way. Practice makes perfect. At the same time, if you are most likely to break, then when you hit it, your strength will be smaller. When its impurities gradually reduce, your strength can begin to gradually increase, Maintaining the effect of hitting is the key. Practice slowly. Don't blindly increase strength and speed. Accuracy is equally important. At least you have to know where you will hit. Otherwise, what's the point of hitting with strength?
The casting hammer returned to Tang San's hands. Tang Hao turned around and went out.
His father did not break his promise. He indeed taught him the casting method. Moreover, judging from the things his father taught him, every industry has its own secrets. It's not that simple.
In the next more than half a month. Tang San practiced the casting method that Tang Hao taught him every day, using force and beating, even though he had the ability to control the strength by controlling cranes and capturing dragons. He has the Purple Demon Eye to determine the position of his hammer blow, but this forging method is more difficult to master than he imagined.
Since it is a full blow. The power itself is difficult to control. With the help of rebound force, it is even more difficult to control the balance of the body and hit the desired position. Without adding one hammer, the control required will increase by a few points. The constant rotation of the body not only makes the brain feel dizzy. At the same time, the force of each hammer blow becomes more difficult to control.
Fortunately, he had been hammering that iron ore for a long time. Impurities of its own have beenVery few, less likely to break. Otherwise, under his casting hammer that cannot control the weight. I'm afraid it has long been broken.
However, during this training process, Tang San was making subtle progress in the operation and application of the Xuantian Technique, as well as in controlling cranes and capturing dragons, and in cooperating with the Mysterious Jade Hands and the Purple Demon Eyes.
From the first day when I could only swing two hammers, I would deviate from the position, to today, half a month later. He can already swing seven hammers continuously and hit the iron block accurately. The progress is very obvious at the same time. The iron block also became smaller and smaller under his full hammering, with results every day.
certainly. This is also closely related to the method of using the calf to exert force. With this method of exerting force, the consumption of Xuantian Gong is greatly saved. This gave Tang San more time to pull the bellows and forge.
Back then, his father wielded thirty-six hammers, and it seemed like he still had some power left, but he only had seven hammers. He didn't know when he would be able to reach his father's level, whenever Tang San thought about this. Those who practice are particularly motivated.
these days. He seemed to have forgotten about martial arts and soul rings. Even when I go to the top of the mountain to practice the Purple Demon Eyes in the early morning. I am also thinking about how to swing the hammer.
Three months passed quickly, when Tang San could swing the hammer and launch thirteen strikes continuously. Tang Hao began to teach him how to forge tools. Tang Hao's teaching method is very direct. Just do it yourself first. Then let Tang San do it again. As long as he was a little beginner, let him practice on his own without giving too much verbal guidance. Only in key places. Only then can I say a sentence or two.
It was precisely because of this that whenever Tang Hao gave advice, Tang San remembered it particularly clearly.
